_doc: Transition catalog for V1 joins. engine: xfade = ffmpeg xfade built-in (fast). dip = fade both sides through a color. whip = slide + directional blur window. cut = hard cut. 'when' is editorial guidance; every transition must be motivated. Default to cut.

cut.when: Default. Action continuity, match cuts, rhythm on the beat. 80%+ of joins in a good edit are cuts.

dissolve.when: Passage of time, soft lifestyle moments, interior to interior with similar light.

dip-black.when: Chapter change, day to night, before the logo.

dip-paper.when: Brand chapter: footage to a DOMUS paper card and back.

whip-left.when: Energetic reels. Needs camera motion in the same direction on both sides (pan right-to-left).

whip-right.when: Mirror of whip-left. For RTL storytelling, rightward whips read as moving forward.

whip-up.when: Tilt-up continuations: facade to sky, floor to ceiling.

whip-down.when: Tilt-down: aerial to entrance, ceiling to living area.

push-left.when: Clean graphic push between spec scenes; commercial and editorial.

zoom-through.when: Doorway or window entry: outgoing shot pushes in, then cut inside. Only when the camera physically moves forward.

focus-blur.when: Soft rack-focus feel between detail shots.

iris.when: Experimental/editorial only (reveal from an arch or round window). Rare.

wipe-arch.when: Graphic opening like doors parting; brand intros.
